title: Text and image requests share a tier-aware queue
summary:
Shared tier-aware queueing gives token-backed image requests more room, while Websim gains optional authenticated text API calls.

Concurrency caps moved into a shared IP queue for text and image requests: 1 for anonymous requests, 3 for seed, 10 for flower, and 30 for nectar. Token-backed image requests are no longer restricted to one concurrent request, and nectar requests no longer bypass the queue.

Token-backed text requests retain a one-second queue interval, while image requests keep a zero-second interval. Token and referrer lookups are cached for 30 seconds.

Websim moved into its own top-level directory, and its worker can send authenticated text API requests when configured. Requests remain token-free otherwise.
